snippet.title: Rita OFFICIAL TRAILER - Release date
snippet.description:
RELEASING - 30 JULY 2026 on Steam

Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

🙏 WISHLIST on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2984850/Rita
🎮 PLAY the Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3837060/Rita_Demo
